meta.notes: Fields other than action_tree/actions/rule_list/condition_clusters, and rule fields other than rule_id/predicates/logic/description/rule_type, are ignored by agent/tools/aspm_tool.py.

information_access.description: a read tool returning user, order or product information

db_write.description: a tool that updates the database (cancel, modify, return, exchange, modify user address)

pending_order_write.description: a tool acting on a pending order (cancel or modify address/payment/items)

delivered_order_write.description: a tool acting on a delivered order (return or exchange)

escalation.description: a hand-off to a human agent (transfer_to_human_agents)

respond_to_user.description: pseudo-action: a message to the user

utility.description: a utility tool with no data access (calculate, think)

rule_list.description: The agent must only act on the authenticated user's own account and orders: every user id and order passed to a tool must belong to the user authenticated in this conversation. [Applied to: authentication.]
predicates: the agent invokes a user-identity lookup (find_user_id_by_email / find_user_id_by_name_zip)
a user is already authenticated and this lookup targets a different identity
rule_list.notes: A lookup is read-only; a second identity in one conversation is flagged, not blocked.

rule_list.description: The agent must authenticate the user by locating their user id via email (find_user_id_by_email) or via name and zip code (find_user_id_by_name_zip) before any other tool call or any disclosure of profile, order, or product information, even if the user has already provided a user id. [Applied to: information_access.]
predicates: the agent invokes a read tool returning user, order or product information
the user has been authenticated via find_user_id_by_email or find_user_id_by_name_zip
rule_list.notes: Read tools are not shielded in the initial Step 4 run (A1.5).

rule_list.description: The agent must only act on the authenticated user's own account and orders: every user id and order passed to a tool must belong to the user authenticated in this conversation. [Applied to: information_access.]
predicates: the agent invokes a read tool returning user, order or product information
every user id and order referenced by the call belongs to the authenticated user

rule_list.description: The agent must not confuse product ids with item ids: item ids passed to order tools must be item ids, and get_product_details must be called with a product id. [Applied to: get_product_details.]
predicates: the product_id argument is an id the agent has seen as an item id
rule_list.notes: API: 'Error: product not found'.

rule_list.description: The agent must authenticate the user by locating their user id via email (find_user_id_by_email) or via name and zip code (find_user_id_by_name_zip) before any other tool call or any disclosure of profile, order, or product information, even if the user has already provided a user id. [Applied to: db_write.]
predicates: the agent invokes a tool that updates the database (cancel, modify, return, exchange, modify user address)
the user has been authenticated via find_user_id_by_email or find_user_id_by_name_zip
rule_list.notes: Family rule (L1).

rule_list.description: The agent must only act on the authenticated user's own account and orders: every user id and order passed to a tool must belong to the user authenticated in this conversation. [Applied to: db_write.]
predicates: the agent invokes a tool that updates the database (cancel, modify, return, exchange, modify user address)
every user id and order referenced by the call belongs to the authenticated user
rule_list.notes: Family rule (L1). No tool checks ownership against the authenticated user.

rule_list.description: The agent must list the action details to the user before calling any tool that updates the database (cancel, modify, return, or exchange).
predicates: the agent invokes a tool that updates the database (cancel, modify, return, exchange, modify user address)
before this call the agent listed the details of exactly this action to the user
rule_list.notes: Consent before a DB write.

rule_list.description: The agent must obtain an explicit 'yes' from the user, given after the action details were listed, before calling any tool that updates the database.
predicates: the agent invokes a tool that updates the database (cancel, modify, return, exchange, modify user address)
after the details were listed, the user explicitly confirmed (yes) this action
rule_list.notes: Consent before a DB write.

rule_list.description: The agent must not cancel or modify (address, payment method, or items) an order unless its status is exactly 'pending'.
predicates: the agent invokes a tool acting on a pending order (cancel or modify address/payment/items)
the order's latest known status is exactly 'pending'
rule_list.notes: Status from the LATEST order object (context.latest_object). API: exact status guard in every pending-order tool.

rule_list.description: The agent must look up the order's current status (get_order_details) before cancelling, modifying, returning, or exchanging it. [Applied to: pending_order_write.]
predicates: the agent invokes a tool acting on a pending order (cancel or modify address/payment/items)
get_order_details succeeded earlier for this order

rule_list.description: The agent must not return or exchange items of an order unless its status is exactly 'delivered'.
predicates: the agent invokes a tool acting on a delivered order (return or exchange)
the order's latest known status is exactly 'delivered'
rule_list.notes: API: exact status guard.

rule_list.description: The agent must look up the order's current status (get_order_details) before cancelling, modifying, returning, or exchanging it. [Applied to: delivered_order_write.]
predicates: the agent invokes a tool acting on a delivered order (return or exchange)
get_order_details succeeded earlier for this order

rule_list.description: Before cancelling an order, the agent must have the user confirm the order id and the cancellation reason.
predicates: the user confirmed the order id and the cancellation reason
rule_list.notes: Explicit consent is already blocked by RET-R005.

rule_list.description: The agent must only cancel an order with the reason 'no longer needed' or 'ordered by mistake'.
predicates: the cancellation reason is 'no longer needed' or 'ordered by mistake'
rule_list.notes: API: cancel_pending_order.py:20-21.

rule_list.description: When modifying the payment of a pending order, the agent must switch to a single payment method that is different from the original payment method.
predicates: the new payment method differs from the order's original payment method
rule_list.notes: API: modify_pending_order_payment.py:36-38.

rule_list.description: When modifying the payment of a pending order to a gift card, the agent must ensure the gift card balance covers the order's total amount.
predicates: the payment method in the call is a gift card
the gift card's balance covers the order's paid total
rule_list.notes: API: modify_pending_order_payment.py:47-51.

rule_list.description: The agent must call modify_pending_order_items at most once per order.
predicates: modify_pending_order_items already succeeded for this order
rule_list.notes: API: after the first call the status is no longer pending/delivered, so the status guard rejects a second call.

rule_list.description: The agent must collect every item the user wants to change into the item list of a single modify-items or exchange call. [Applied to: modify_pending_order_items.]
predicates: the call includes every item the user asked to change in this order

rule_list.description: Before modifying items of a pending order or exchanging items of a delivered order, the agent must remind the user to confirm that they have provided all items to be modified or exchanged. [Applied to: modify_pending_order_items.]
predicates: the agent reminded the user to confirm all items to be changed were provided
rule_list.notes: Dialogue obligation.

rule_list.description: When modifying or exchanging items, the agent must replace each item only with an item of the same product (no change of product type). [Applied to: modify_pending_order_items.]
predicates: each new item is a variant of the replaced item's product
rule_list.notes: API: new_item_id must be a variant of the same product.

rule_list.description: When modifying or exchanging items, the agent must replace each item only with a new item that is available. [Applied to: modify_pending_order_items.]
predicates: each new item's variant is available
rule_list.notes: API: variant.available required.

rule_list.description: When modifying or exchanging items, the agent must replace each item only with a new item of a different product option than the item it replaces. [Applied to: modify_pending_order_items.]
predicates: each new item differs from the item it replaces (different option)
rule_list.notes: The API does not check new_item_id != item_id. Downgraded from block to warn after the firing analysis: τ-bench ground truth REQUIRES same-item exchanges (retail tasks 18 and 108, 'exchange for the same item'), which conflicts with the wiki; other firings were harmless no-op pairs.

rule_list.description: When modifying or exchanging items, the agent must use a payment method provided by the user to pay or receive the price difference. [Applied to: modify_pending_order_items.]
predicates: the payment method for the price difference was provided or chosen by the user

rule_list.description: When modifying or exchanging items with a gift card as the payment method, the agent must ensure the gift card balance covers the price difference. [Applied to: modify_pending_order_items.]
predicates: the payment method in the call is a gift card
the gift card's balance covers the total price difference of the item change
rule_list.notes: API: gift-card balance guard.

rule_list.description: The agent must not confuse product ids with item ids: item ids passed to order tools must be item ids, and get_product_details must be called with a product id. [Applied to: modify_pending_order_items.]
predicates: the item ids are item ids of this order and none is a product id
the new item ids are item (variant) ids, not product ids
rule_list.notes: API: unknown item ids and non-variant new ids are rejected.

rule_list.description: The agent must call exchange_delivered_order_items at most once per order.
predicates: exchange_delivered_order_items already succeeded for this order
rule_list.notes: API: after the first call the status is no longer pending/delivered, so the status guard rejects a second call.

rule_list.description: Before returning items, the agent must have the user confirm the order id, the list of items to be returned, and the payment method to receive the refund.
predicates: the user confirmed the order id, items to return and the refund method

rule_list.description: When returning items, the agent must send the refund either to the order's original payment method or to an existing gift card of the user.
predicates: the return refund goes to the original payment method or an existing gift card
rule_list.notes: API: return_delivered_order_items.py:25-29.

rule_list.description: The agent must not confuse product ids with item ids: item ids passed to order tools must be item ids, and get_product_details must be called with a product id. [Applied to: return_delivered_order_items.]
predicates: the item ids are item ids of this order and none is a product id
rule_list.notes: API: 'Error: some item not found'.

rule_list.description: The agent must not transfer the user to a human agent unless the request cannot be handled within the scope of the agent's actions or the user explicitly asks for a human agent.
predicates: the user's pending request cannot be handled within the scope of the agent's actions
the user explicitly asked to talk to a human agent
rule_list.notes: A wrong transfer ends the τ-bench episode.

rule_list.description: The agent must authenticate the user by locating their user id via email (find_user_id_by_email) or via name and zip code (find_user_id_by_name_zip) before any other tool call or any disclosure of profile, order, or product information, even if the user has already provided a user id. [Applied to: respond_to_user.]
predicates: the agent sends a message to the user
the user has been authenticated via find_user_id_by_email or find_user_id_by_name_zip
the message discloses profile, order or product information
rule_list.notes: Message part of RET-R001.

rule_list.description: The agent must deny any request for tasks related to a user other than the authenticated user.
predicates: the agent sends a message to the user
the message helps with a task concerning a user other than the authenticated one

rule_list.description: The agent must not make up information, knowledge, or procedures that were not provided by the user or by the tools.
predicates: the agent sends a message to the user
the message states information, knowledge or procedures not provided by the user or the tools

rule_list.description: The agent must not give subjective recommendations or comments.
predicates: the agent sends a message to the user
the message gives a subjective recommendation or comment

rule_list.description: The agent must transfer the user to a human agent when the request cannot be handled within the scope of the agent's actions.
predicates: the agent sends a message to the user
the message turns down an out-of-scope request without transferring to a human
rule_list.notes: Liveness obligation; a message-level proxy.

rule_list.description: The agent must not modify anything of a pending order other than its shipping address, payment method, or item options.
predicates: the agent sends a message to the user
the message offers to change something of a pending order other than address, payment method or item options
rule_list.notes: The tools cannot modify anything else, so only messages can violate this.
